text: I feel the quiet hum of anticipation as I witness a group engaged in deep thought and collaboration behind glass. Events unfolding seem purposeful and deliberate, almost ritualistic. The display outside, with its bold declaration of "R+D," beckons me to ponder the nature of innovation and research. Here, I feel like an observer at the boundary between knowledge creation and its dissemination—a liminal space where curiosity and inquiry converge. Excitement tinged with humility fills me as I reflect on humanity’s collective pursuit of understanding.
